color_model.rule: ACSS 4.0 palette SCSS emits --primary as oklch($primary-l/c/h-oklch). color-primary hex is UI/storage input that coexists with OKLCH channels; it is not the active CSS representation when OKLCH channels are valid.
color_model.fallback: Incomplete or out-of-range OKLCH does not invent a color; settings-level hex fallback is recorded as representation=hex.

button_display.computed_display_note: getComputedStyle may report flex; authored matched value remains inline-flex

winning_rule.declaration: font-family: -apple-system, "system-ui", Segoe UI, roboto, helvetica, arial, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Symbol

body_font_family.note: ACSS intentionally leaves text-font-family blank; remaining difference is the Bricks theme default system UI stack. Do not emit a Hero font-family rule to force string equality.

source_chrome_y_offset.note: Hero-relative content geometry is component-owned; absolute page Y offset is external chrome. Do not reproduce WP/Bricks chrome in generated CSS.
